2. Compute discriminant Δ = b² - 4ac.
3. If Δ > 0: two real roots, x = [-b ± √Δ]/(2a).
   Δ = 0: one real root, x = -b/(2a).
   Δ < 0: two complex roots.

Stationary points are where the gradient is zero (max/min/inflection).

3. Find y = f(x) for those points.
4. Classify using second derivative test: f''(x) > 0 local min, < 0 local max, =0 inconclusive—use first deriv sign chart.
